selection: 16 targeted methodological examples;11 DAC/ISCA/MICRO/ASPLOS/HPCA and5 complementary DATE/CASES/ISLPED/ICML; not a systematic survey or popularity estimate
null_semantics: not established in inspected source; not equivalent to absent or zero
sources_policy: Original papers, author versions and official code/documentation. Web sources recorded by URL/version/locator; no publisher full-text redistribution.

papers.name: OPAL
papers.source_version: arXiv v3; header contains placeholders; venue independently verified
papers.quality_reference: BF16 and OWQ weight-only quantized controls; different comparisons
papers.workload: Generation one-token evaluation; exact batch/context for all hardware results not sufficiently disclosed in inspected section
papers.performance_scope: generation token energy and accelerator/core hardware
papers.physical_method: RTL except SRAM; Design Compiler synthesis; CACTI on-chip memory including leakage
papers.dram_model: External DRAM command/state energy pipeline not established by §5.2; CACTI described for on-chip SRAM
papers.validation: Numerical software tests; inspected method does not establish full post-layout chip calibration
papers.pitfall: Do not equate '<1 average PPL increase' with <5% for every model or with zero error relative to BF16.

papers.name: MoNDE
papers.quality_reference: Exact numerical changes are not the central mechanism; do not invent a new PPL table
papers.workload: Encoder and decoder; batch/sequence sweeps for sparse experts
papers.physical_method: NDP Design Compiler; commercial memory compiler for on-chip buffers; expert cycle model + Ramulator + measured profiling
papers.dram_model: Micron DDR4-3200 power calculator, voltage-adjusted to LPDDR
papers.area_boundary: Added NDP logic/buffer; GPU platform retained separately
papers.validation: Measured host execution profiling plus simulated NDP expert execution
papers.pitfall: A heterogeneous MoE system result is not a same-model dense ASIC result; DDR to LPDDR voltage scaling remains an approximation.

papers.name: UniCAIM
papers.workload: Circuit: 576 KV tokens (512 heavy +64 decode), d=128; application prompts about 1.5k and 2.5k
papers.performance_scope: Attention circuit area/energy/delay/AEDP and separate pruning quality
papers.physical_method: HSPICE, 45nm BSIM + Preisach FeFET, wire parasitics, 10-bit SAR ADC, 64 parallel sensing ADCs
papers.dram_model: Circuit attention/cache evaluation; external DRAM whole-system accounting not established
papers.area_boundary: FeFET attention circuits including modeled periphery
papers.validation: Circuit simulation and application pruning algorithm tests are separate evidence
papers.pitfall: AEDP gains are not full-LLM J/token gains; matching pruning ratios does not establish matching process/PVT.

papers.name: MBA: Mega-Buffer Architecture Based on 1T1C IGZO eDRAM for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.quality_reference: WikiText2 used as generation workload; no new PPL/task score found in inspected paper
papers.workload: Main prefill512, output256/512/1024, B1/4/16; Figure8 different fixed/varying lengths
papers.performance_scope: behavior-level graph simulation, whole-model latency/energy plus buffer ablations
papers.physical_method: PE costs from NB-SMT45nm scaled with DeepScaleTool to7nm; modified FinCACTI eDRAM; SFU/NoC cited component models
papers.dram_model: HBM1.5TB/s, fixed3.9pJ/bit; detailed command/state power pipeline not disclosed
papers.area_boundary: Estimated accelerator total569.87mm2; not an established full-chip P&R result
papers.validation: Referenced prior eDRAM testchip is distinct from the proposed MBA accelerator; end-to-end error calibration not disclosed
papers.pitfall: A100 comparison measurement procedure is unclear; do not call it a measured GPU run. Buffer-management ablation differs from full GPU-vs-system gains.

papers.name: Kelle
papers.source_version: author camera-ready PDF; arXiv2510.16040v1 used only as parallel text aid
papers.quality_reference: Original FP16; W8A16 Kelle and additional quantized variants
papers.workload: B16; task-specific input/output lengths; both phases, off-chip accesses included
papers.performance_scope: End-to-end edge accelerator inference and matched-area architecture ablations
papers.physical_method: SystemVerilog DC45nm Nangate logic; Destiny65nm/105C SRAM/eDRAM; CACTI7 LPDDR4
papers.dram_model: CACTI7 estimate for16GB LPDDR4 at64GB/s; external time/energy included
papers.area_boundary: On-chip accelerator9.5mm2 reported separately from external memory
papers.validation: Model quality tests, RTL synthesis and memory models; full P&R not established in inspected section
papers.pitfall: The model combines45nm logic with65nm memory costs; published acceptance of a larger PPL change is not an acceptance criterion for our design.

papers.name: AttAcc
papers.quality_reference: Timing/energy systems study; model shape is not proof of full checkpoint quality validation
papers.workload: Lin/Lout128/512/2048 combinations; max batch under capacity/SLO;30/50/70ms targets
papers.physical_method: Modified Ramulator; ASAP7 DC arithmetic; modified FinCACTI; DRAM die area scaling
papers.dram_model: Prior HBM ACT/read energy; datapath length scaling; DRAM die logic area projected to1z process
papers.area_boundary: PIM arithmetic/buffers and HBM overhead plus GPU-system configuration
papers.validation: Performance calibrated against real DGX A100 OPT66B; not proof of energy-model calibration
papers.pitfall: LLAMA and GPT3 use FP16; MT-NLG uses INT8. Same capacity/max-batch and B1 latency answer different questions.

papers.name: NeuPIMs
papers.quality_reference: Configuration/trace evaluation, not actual proprietary GPT3 checkpoint accuracy
papers.workload: ShareGPT/Alpaca request lengths; batch64–512 sweeps; initialized/steady inference conventions
papers.performance_scope: Batched serving compute/memory timing; cited power table concerns memory
papers.physical_method: ONNXim extension + PIM DRAMsim3; CACTI7 row-buffer area22nm
papers.dram_model: Micron power model in DRAMsim3; all-bank compute power assumed4x RD; added row-buffer background
papers.area_boundary: Main explicit new area estimate is dual row-buffer overhead; not a full P&R chip
papers.validation: Architectural simulator + modeled new commands; power assumptions explicit
papers.pitfall: 1.8x power and2.4x speed refer to inspected memory accounting, not calibrated whole-NPU system PPA.

papers.name: CENT / PIM Is All You Need
papers.quality_reference: Functional computation/trace validation; do not infer every model has full PPL report
papers.workload: 512 prompt +3584 generation; maximum batch; prefill/decode/E2E separated; artifact permits sampled token positions
papers.performance_scope: CXL PIM system versus A100 GPU, latency/throughput/power/token-per-J
papers.physical_method: Modified Ramulator2 and activity-based component system model
papers.dram_model: PIM/DRAM activity cost accounting includes ACT/PRE and compute
papers.area_boundary: PIM/CXL devices; GPU board power separately measured
papers.validation: Functional trace basis; GPU nvidia-smi100ms power; simulation sampling option documented
papers.pitfall: Maximum batch may differ by system. Report sampling stride if artifact interpolates rather than simulates every token.

papers.name: Anda
quality_metrics: relative accuracy metric as defined by paper
papers.quality_reference: OmniQuant and alternatives; tolerances defined by authors, not universal PPL bounds
papers.workload: B1; WikiText2-derived shapes; FP-INT GEMM focus, other operations/KV retained FP16
papers.performance_scope: PE and accelerator FP-INT GEMM efficiency; not unrestricted full-LLM E2E
papers.physical_method: 16nm Genus, synthesized-netlist VCD power, cycle-accurate simulator verified with functional simulations
papers.validation: Functional simulator verification; not a stated independent silicon PPA calibration
papers.pitfall: BOP reduction and a 'system-level' GEMM speedup are not automatically end-to-end request speedup.

papers.name: LLMCompass
papers.source_version: preprint v1 figures; final venue verified by official code repository
papers.quality_reference: Hardware performance/cost framework, not an approximate-arithmetic quality study
papers.workload: Prefill and decode shapes, mappings, multiple accelerators
papers.physical_method: Tile-level model with local compute/communication simulation and area cost models
papers.dram_model: Configured bandwidth/capacity hierarchy; do not infer target-DRAM power model
papers.area_boundary: Area-based cost model rather than a full synthesized chip
papers.validation: v1 reports average operator latency error10.4%, LLM latency error4.1%; these are performance errors
papers.pitfall: A calibrated timing framework does not by itself validate energy, stochastic-source behavior or our new modules.

papers.name: Splitwise
papers.quality_reference: Exact model serving/phase scheduling, not new approximate math
papers.workload: Production-style requests, Poisson arrivals, prompt/output distributions and continuous batching
papers.performance_scope: TTFT/TBT/E2E p50/p90/p99 SLO, request throughput, cluster resources
papers.physical_method: Measured A100/H100 profiles + discrete-event simulator + KV-transfer benchmark
papers.dram_model: Measured platform performance/communication; not a newly synthesized DRAM PPA model
papers.area_boundary: Cluster cost/power provisioning rather than ASIC core area
papers.validation: Piecewise latency model MAPE<3% on80:20 split; >50k iterations end-to-end validation
papers.pitfall: Provisioned power budget and actual J/output token must not be equated.

papers.name: DS-CIM
papers.quality_reference: Full precision66.3%, FP8 avg66.0%, DS1 avg62.6%, DS2 avg58.8% (table rounded)
papers.workload: Macro T64/128/256; LLM error injection uses T256
papers.performance_scope: Macro peak TOPS/W and TOPS/mm2; separate model quality
papers.physical_method: Custom SNG/OR cells characterized;40nm DC + Innovus + Virtuoso post-layout
papers.dram_model: No full LLM external DRAM timing/energy pipeline established
papers.validation: Post-layout macro simulation; DS-CIM error-pattern injection into quantized MVM
papers.pitfall: Do not bind T256 LLM quality to T64 peak efficiency; table scaling is40nm/1b input/1b weight, formula not fully disclosed.

papers.name: ARTEMIS
papers.workload: Layer/model mappings for heterogeneous Transformer workloads; modern7B decode not established
papers.performance_scope: In-DRAM mapping performance/energy and circuit overhead
papers.physical_method: Python mapping simulator; LTSPICE tile latency; Genus digital periphery; CACTI-3D
papers.dram_model: 22nm HBM-derived ACT and pre/post-GSA and I/O energy table
papers.area_boundary: DRAM subarray modification and system model
papers.validation: Circuit error integrated into model; not full7B fabricated LLM system
papers.pitfall: BLEU17.79→17.49 is not a PPL change;128bit+sign stochastic representation differs from our FFN.

papers.name: SCARLET
papers.quality_reference: FP16; quantization and approximate multiplication in modified Hugging Face models
papers.workload: Prefill/generation and macro-size/batch sweeps; do not infer all hardware and quality points identical
papers.performance_scope: Photonic crossbar/module and accelerator estimates; phase latency
papers.physical_method: Photonic/device/peripheral component models; HardFloat digital units; GF22FDX SRAM scaled to7nm
papers.dram_model: HBM20pJ/bit;40ns same interposer/80ns cross interposer; CXL64GB/s
papers.area_boundary: Hybrid photonic and digital chiplet components; not all objects share a CMOS node
papers.validation: Approximate arithmetic quality simulation; read section does not establish device drift in full-model quality
papers.pitfall: Next-token argmax accuracy cannot substitute for PPL, and the SRAM scaling is not whole-device process normalization.

papers.name: Hybrid Systolic Array (HSA)
quality_metrics: GSM8K generative accuracy for Instruct Llama
papers.performance_scope: RetNet end-to-end prefill/decode; token-related summary metrics count input+output
papers.area_boundary: Accelerator28nm post-layout; external memory energy separately included where marked
papers.validation: Post-layout hardware simulation; additional model numerical tests
papers.pitfall: Hardware RetNet1.3B and Llama quality are distinct cases; summary tokens include prompts.

papers.name: SANTA / S²ANTA
papers.workload: Table3: BF16 RTX6000Ada,30k prompt,B6,2048 outputs,9batches; dense prefill
papers.performance_scope: Attention kernel and full decode measured separately; no ASIC PPA
papers.dram_model: Actual GPU cache/memory behavior; not a target-ASIC DRAM estimator
papers.validation: GPU timing and numerical tasks; do not assign GPU runtime simulation to p-bit hardware
papers.pitfall: ms/output token divides by B×G; decode speedup is not full-request speedup.
